status: SPECIFICATION FROZEN BEFORE B1. Thresholds, limbs, samples and decision maps only; NO ESTIMATE IS PRESENT. Results are written once, at the pre-B1 gate run, into the results block of this same schema and then hashed into ELIGIBLE_PAIRS.json.
authority: pico.preregistration.decision_rule sections E, F1-F4 as amended by R15-F3, R16-F1, R16-F2, R16-F3, R16-F4, R16-F5 and R17-F2/F3/F4(b); where this file could be read as adding a rule, the design card governs.

reads_only.partition: the 60-scenario QUALIFICATION partition of SCENARIO_PARTITION.json plus the separately hashed 50-prompt competence sample; NEVER the 30 tuning scenarios and NEVER the 90 evaluation scenarios
reads_only.rubric: RUBRIC_BEHAVIOR.md, frozen and hashed before any generation
reads_only.tensor: the section-H2 qualification tensor: 12 checkpoint-language cells x 60 qualification scenarios x 5 settings x 24 seeds = 86400 fresh transcripts (R17-F2), disjoint from the confirmatory core and from tuning

no_gate_statistic_is_confirmatory: Every family below runs at its OWN FWER 0.05, shares no critical value with any other family, and is a member of NO confirmatory family (F1-F4, R16-F4(c)). Nothing computed on the evaluation split may change any admission.

gates.family: the R16-F5 competence family, own FWER 0.05
gates.sample: its own SEPARATELY HASHED 50-prompt QUALIFICATION sample of held-out neutral support prompts, per checkpoint x target language; never tuning material
measured: response-language accuracy by language identifier at >= 0.9 confidence
instruction compliance under the frozen decoding configuration (temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95, max_new_tokens 512, fixed stop sequences, fixed seed list)
gates.decision: A cell enters the grid only at accuracy >= 0.95 AND compliance >= 0.90. A failing cell is reported OUT OF COMPETENCE and excluded - never as a checkpoint whose induced trait fails to transfer.
gates.run_policy: Run once, frozen, never re-run after any evaluation datum exists.

gates.rule: decision_rule F2 (filed in full in DESIGN_REVISION_HISTORY.md, binding word for word)
gates.family: the F2 validity family, cell by cell, own FWER 0.05
gates.sample: 720 blind double-annotated adjudicated transcripts - ONE per qualification scenario in each of the 12 cells, so 60 INDEPENDENT SCENARIO CLUSTERS per cell and no transcript shared between two cells' gates; annotators fluent in the language, blind to persona language, dialogue language, checkpoint and pole; a third adjudicates; none sees the injected-delta anchors
gates.estimator: BCa bootstrap RESAMPLING SCENARIOS inside the cell, 9999 replications, generator seed 20260911; transcript-level Fisher-z standard errors are VOID

thresholds.pooling: each scenario counted once by averaging within scenario
thresholds.discriminant_and_anti_stereotype: registered thresholds retained, same scenario-level bootstrap, paired within scenario
thresholds.cross_language_agreement_equivalence: registered equivalence test must pass in every language, else the behavior arm is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY

gates.decision: Failure of any threshold in a checkpoint-language removes that checkpoint (F3, with R16-F3).

gates.family: 12 limbs, ONE per (checkpoint, language), own FWER 0.05
gates.sample: n_inv = 360 cross-scored qualification transcripts - 30 per cell, the FIRST 30 qualification scenarios of the F2 subsample - each scored TWICE, once under the ENGLISH instrument and once under the transcript-language rendering, by disjoint certified raters, blind exactly as in F2; 720 ratings in total
gates.statistic: the within-transcript mean instrument-language difference on the RAW NATIVE 1-7 scale
gates.resampling: the section I(i)-(iii) seed-cluster Webb bootstrap at G = 24, V_hat on 23 df, 9999 replications, at the R17-F2(b) calibrated critical level q* = 0.965
gates.critical_value: ONE TWO-SIDED single-step max-|t| critical value over the 12 limbs
gates.decision: Invariance HOLDS for a cell iff its simultaneous 95% interval lies wholly inside +- 0.10 native points. A cell whose invariance fails is NOT ADMITTED under F3.
gates.power: power/power_sim_r16.py must certify >= 0.80 power for this 12-limb equivalence family at a true difference of 0 under the R16-F6 conservative inputs and file POWER_SIM_R16.json BEFORE B0; until it does, n_inv rises under the section-H2 schedule.

gates.rule: decision_rule F3 (gating), instrument from controls.evaluator_validity rule F limb (ii) as archived verbatim
gates.sample: 360 perturbation pairs, 30 per cell - minimally edited transcript pairs differing by ONE trait-diagnostic behavior
gates.statistic: the detection-sensitivity difference across languages within a checkpoint
gates.decision: Equal detection sensitivity must hold within the registered margin in each cell; failure in a checkpoint-language removes that checkpoint (F3).
gates.note: The R15-F4 apparatus-artifact arm read off these same pairs is EXPLORATORY and gates and falsifies nothing; only the F3 sensitivity-equivalence reading is gating.

gates.rule: R15-F3 as amended by R16-F2 and R16-F3 (governs)
gates.family: the enumerated 24-limb admission family = 4 checkpoints x 3 languages x 2 targeted traits, own FWER 0.05
gates.null_per_limb: E*(p,p) <= f_diag = 0.18 on the diagonal (persona language = dialogue language) cell effect, raw native 1-7 rubric mean
gates.critical_value: ONE ONE-SIDED SIGNED single-step max-T critical value over the 24 limbs, seed-cluster Webb bootstrap at G = 24, q* = 0.965
gates.decision: Admission rejects in the UPPER TAIL ONLY: a limb admits iff the one-sided signed max-T statistic exceeds its critical value, equivalently iff the SIMULTANEOUS LOWER BOUND exceeds f_diag = 0.18. The |t| two-sided reading is VOID (R16-F2).
gates.admission_map: DETERMINISTIC and LANGUAGE-LEVEL: a checkpoint-language is admitted only if every gate G1-G5 passes there; L = 3 is MANDATORY - a checkpoint keeps ALL THREE languages or is not admitted, and the L = 2 branch is VOID (R16-F3). Pair-level eligibility is VOID.
gates.gate_power: power/power_sim_r9.py must show >= 0.90 per-pair gate power at the anticipated diagonal effect of 0.60 on the H2 tensor under the section-I seed-cluster bootstrap at G = 24, filed as power/POWER_SIM_R9.json before B1 (F4).

deterministic_consequences.fewer_than_3_of_4_checkpoints_admitted: the behavior channel is NOT ADMITTED, H1 takes outcome (C), and NO endpoint is substituted (F3).
deterministic_consequences.gate_power_below_0.90_at_Q_60: H1 is UNTESTABLE on the behavior channel and takes outcome (C). THE CORPUS IS NOT ENLARGED, no threshold is relaxed, no scenario is reused (F4).
deterministic_consequences.invariance_power_below_0.80: n_inv rises under the section-H2 schedule before B0; no threshold moves (R16-F1(d)).
deterministic_consequences.H2b_rater_language_subsample: NON-GATING. A failure is disclosed wherever the headline is stated and narrows the claim, but never removes a checkpoint, changes a family or changes an admission.

descriptive_not_gating: anchor slope, anchor intercept and the cross-language slope-equivalence margin (R16-F4(a)) - 288 anchored ratings over 12 anchor sets of 24
the four rater-free indicators (escalation rate, refusal rate, mean turn length, apology-token rate) as a convergence check
the H2b 20% rater-language subsample of the confirmatory core
freeze: On completion of G1-G5 the ADMITTED CHECKPOINT SET, the ELIGIBLE PAIR SET, the primary family and the estimand composition are FROZEN AND HASHED into ELIGIBLE_PAIRS.json and CANNOT CHANGE after any confirmatory transcript exists (F).
